request: Read actual result or still-running state of single restart-during-handoff/abort acceptance from already-running bounded Docker test. Sanitize results to structural fields, no secret/output dump, no models restart.

bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
name=ai-core-handoff-restart-01ef
s=$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Status}}' "$name")
if test "$s" = exited; then
 rc=$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.ExitCode}}' "$name")
 out=$(docker logs --tail 1 "$name" 2>/dev/null | docker exec -i ai-core-model-gate python3 -c 'import sys,json; d=json.loads(sys.stdin.read()); fields=("step","cleanup","emergency_abort"); a={k:d.get(k) for k in fields}; a["error_type"]=str(d.get("error","")).split(":")[0]; a["two"]=d.get("two",{}).get("resident"); a["three"]=d.get("three",{}).get("resident"); a["restart"]=d.get("after_restart",{}).get("resident"); a["abort"]=d.get("after_abort",{}).get("resident"); a["final"]=d.get("final",{}).get("resident"); a["active"]=sum(d.get("final",{}).get("active",{}).values()); a["queue"]=d.get("final",{}).get("queued"); print(json.dumps(a))')
 msg="AI_CORE_UDS_GATE_RESTART_ACCEPTANCE FINAL_EXIT=$rc RESULT=$out"
else
 msg="AI_CORE_UDS_GATE_RESTART_ACCEPTANCE PROCESS_STATUS=$s NO_RETRY=YES"
fi
gh api -X POST repos/seigo-gace/ai-core/issues/1/comments -f body="$msg" --jq '.html_url' >/dev/null
echo CORE_GATE_RESTART_READBACK=RECORDED

chat_decision_checkpoint.source_evidence: AI Core Issue1 #6223964281 confirms once-only isolated bounded physical restart test started on PR3 Source 01ef4da9 after true zero-model/idle preflight. Readback only, do not duplicate inference; DebugAI separate.
